sn46.6:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sākete viharati Añcanavane Migadāye || || 2.
sn46.6:1.2: Atha kho Kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn46.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca|| || 3
sn46.6:1.4: Aham asmi bho Gotama ārāmanisādi parisāvacaro ||
sn46.6:1.5: tassa mayham bho Gotama pacchābhattam bhuttapātarāsassa ayam ācāro hoti ||
sn46.6:1.6: ārāmena ārāmam uyyānena uyyānam anucaṅkamāmi anuvicarāmi ||
sn46.6:1.7: so tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe itivādapamokkhānisaṃsaṃ ceva katham kathente upārambhānisaṃsañ ca ||
sn46.6:2.1: Katame pana bho Gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttim paripūrentīti || ||
sn46.6:2.2: Satta kho Kuṇḍaliya sambojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulikatā vijjāvimuttim paripūrentī ti || || 5.
sn46.6:2.3: Katame pana bho Gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sattabojjhaṅge paripūrentī ti || ||
sn46.6:2.4: Cattāro kho Kuṇḍaliya satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sattabojjhaṅge paripūrentī ti || || 6.
sn46.6:2.5: Katame pana bho Gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrentī ti || ||
sn46.6:2.6: Tīṇi kho Kuṇḍaliya sucaritāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrentīti || || 7.
sn46.6:2.7: Katame pana bho Gotama dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā tiṇi sucaritāni paripūrentīti || ||
sn46.6:2.8: Indriyasaṃvaro kho Kuṇḍaliya bhāvito bahulīkato tīni sucaritāni paripūrentīti || ||
sn46.6:3.1: Katham bhāvito ca Kuṇḍaliya indriyasaṃvaro katham bahulīkato tīni sucaritāni paripūreti || || 8.
sn46.6:3.2: Idha Kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā manāpaṃ nābhijjhati nābhihaṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti ||
sn46.6:3.3: tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ || ||
sn46.6:3.4: Cakkhunā kho paneva rūpaṃ disvā amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti || apatiṭṭhitacitto ādīnamānaso avyāpannacetaso ||
sn46.6:3.5: tassa ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittam ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitam suvimuttaṃ || || 9-12.
sn46.6:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ Kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu sotena saddam sutvā || la [pe] ||
sn46.6:4.5: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpaṃ nābhijjhati nābhihaṃsati na rāgaṃ janeti ||
sn46.6:4.6: tassa ṭhito va kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittam ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ || ||
sn46.6:4.7: Manasā kho paneva dhammaṃ viññāya amanāpaṃ na maṅku hoti || apatiṭṭhitacitto ādīnamanaso avyāpannacetaso ||
sn46.6:4.8: tassa ṭhito va kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittam ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ || || 14.
sn46.6:5.1: Yato kho Kuṇḍaliya bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpam disvā manāpāmanāpesu rūpesu ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittam ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitam suvimuttam ||
sn46.6:5.6: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya manāpāmanāpesu dhammesu ṭhito ca kāyo hoti ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ susaṇṭhitam suvimuttaṃ ||
sn46.6:5.7: evam bhāvito kho Kuṇḍaliya indriyasaṃvaro evam bahulīkato tīni sucaritāni paripūreti || || 15.
sn46.6:6.1: Katham bhāvitāni ca Kuṇḍaliya tīṇi sucaritāni katham bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrenti || ||
sn46.6:6.2: Idha Kuṇḍaliya khikkhu kāyaduccaritam pahāya kāyasucaritam bhāveti || vacīduccaritam pahāya vacīsucaritam bhaveti || manoduccaritam pahāya manosucaritam bhāveti || ||
sn46.6:6.3: Evam bhāvitāni kho Kuṇḍaliya tīṇi sucaritāni evam bahulīkatāni cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūrenti || || 16.
sn46.6:7.1: Katham bhāvitā ca Kuṇḍaliya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā katham bahulīkatā sattabojjhaṅge paripūrenti || ||
sn46.6:7.2: Idha Kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn46.6:7.5: dhamme dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn46.6:7.6: Evam bhāvitā kho Kuṇḍaliya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā evam bahulīkatā satta bojjhaṅge paripūrenti || || 17.
sn46.6:8.1: Katham bhāvitā ca Kuṇḍaliya satta bojjhaṅgā katham bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttim paripūrenti || ||
sn46.6:8.2: Idha Kuṇḍaliya bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāganirodanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || la ||
sn46.6:8.3: upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || ||
sn46.6:8.4: Evam bhāvitā kho Kuṇḍaliya satta bojjhaṅgā evam bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrentīti || || 18.
sn46.6:9.1: Evaṃ vutte Kuṇḍaliyo paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
